**Job Title:** Cinema Technician

**Department:** Technical Operations  
**Reports To:** Technical Manager / Cinema Manager  
**Location:** Velachery chennai  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** 18500 \- 22000

**Job Summary:**

The Cinema Technician is responsible for the operation, maintenance, and repair of cinema projection and audio systems, ensuring a seamless and high\-quality viewing experience for all patrons. This role includes regular maintenance, emergency troubleshooting, and support of both digital and mechanical projection equipment, as well as associated cinema technology systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Operate, calibrate, and maintain digital cinema projection systems (DCP, 2K/4K projectors, etc.).
* Monitor and fine\-tune sound systems (Dolby, DTS, 5\.1/7\.1 surround) to deliver optimal audio quality.
* Conduct regular preventative maintenance on projectors, audio systems, servers, and networking hardware.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during screenings with minimal disruption.
* Upload, schedule, and test film content, including DCP ingestion and playlist creation.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and safety regulations.
* Coordinate with third\-party vendors for repairs, upgrades, and system installations.
* Maintain technical logs, incident reports, and maintenance records.
* Provide technical support for live events, including satellite feeds, streaming, and interactive Q\&A sessions.
* Assist with lighting, automation systems, and theatre environmental controls when required.
* Train junior staff or projectionists as needed.

**Skills \& Qualifications:**

**Essential:**

* Strong technical expertise in digital cinema projection and audio systems.
* Hands\-on experience with server\-based systems (Dolby, Doremi, GDC, or similar).
* Proficiency in content management workflows (DCP ingestion, KDMs, SPLs).
* Ability to efficiently troubleshoot AV, networking, and hardware issues.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹18,500\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Job description:**

We are looking for qualified engineers for design, development, testing, and troubleshooting of power electronic systems. The role involves working with power converters, inverters, and control circuits to support industrial and automation projects.

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Design and development of power electronic converters (AC\-DC, DC\-DC, DC\-AC).
* Selection and testing of power semiconductor devices such as MOSFETs, IGBTs, diodes, and gate drivers.
* Design and debugging of SMPS, rectifiers, inverters, and DC\-DC converter circuits.
* Simulation and analysis using tools like MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice, PLECS, etc.
* Testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of power electronic hardware.
* Thermal analysis, efficiency calculation, and loss estimation of power systems.
* Design support for PCB layout in high\-power and high\-frequency applications.
* Implementation of protection circuits (overcurrent, overvoltage, short circuit, thermal protection).
* Documentation of circuit designs, test reports, and technical specifications.
* Provide technical support to production and maintenance teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills in power electronics systems.

**Required Experience, Skills, and Qualifications:**

* Fresher also applicable
* Knowledge of power converter topologies (Buck, Boost, Flyback, Forward, Full\-Bridge, Half\-Bridge).
* Strong understanding of semiconductor devices and switching principles.
* Familiarity with magnetics design (transformers and inductors basics).
* Understanding of analog and digital control concepts.
* Ability to read and interpret circuit schematics and datasheets.
* Basic knowledge of PCB design guidelines for power electronics.
* Hands\-on experience with lab equipment (oscilloscope, multimeter, power analyzer).
* **Degree (B.E) or Diploma in EEE / Power Electronics .**
* **We are also hiring Service Executives For the Hyderabad and Vaisak locations.**
